lastSummary: NC-012 fixed: Cancellation propagation through tools and child processes. (1) TerminalTool.run(), runSafe(), stream() accept optional AbortSignal parameter. (2) When signal fires, child process tree is killed cross-platform (taskkill /T on Windows, process group SIGTERM on POSIX). (3) Already-aborted signal causes immediate rejection (fast-fail). (4) Signal cleanup prevents memory leaks — listener removed in both exec callback and close event. (5) ToolRegistry.runToolCall() and runToolCallStructured() pass signal through to all tools. (6) GitTool: all methods accept signal. (7) TestRunnerTool: run() and stream() accept signal. (8) Orchestrator passes abortSignal to tool calls and terminal streaming. (9) AgentLoop passes signal to ToolRegistry.runToolCall(). (10) 30 regression tests in cancellationPropagation.test.ts. 1271/1272 tests pass (1 pre-existing approvalPolicy path issue). Build clean. All type-checks clean.
